description: This file defines the Menu class representing a menu entity with properties such as code, url, icon, role, order, and nested menus. It's part of the web.admin.entity.web package and provides getter and setter methods for serialization/deserialization with JSON.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Represents a web menu item with nested submenus, identifiers, icons, roles, and order properties.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier of the menu.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier of the menu.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the menu.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the menu.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the menu.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the menu.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role required to access the menu.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role required to access the menu.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the display order of the menu.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the menu.

methods.name: getMenus
methods.description: Returns the list of nested submenus.

methods.name: setMenus
methods.description: Sets the list of nested submenus.
